name: Staples Teacher Rewards
description: 20% off in-store with teacher ID and app coupon
fullDescription: Staples offers teachers and school staff 20% off in-store purchases with a teacher coupon in the Staples app and a school ID, plus back-to-school savings and rewards.
whatTheyOffer:
- 20% off in-store with app coupon and teacher/school ID
- Back-to-school supply deals
- Staples Rewards on purchases
howToGetIt:
1. Download the Staples app
2. Find and clip the teacher discount coupon in the app
3. Present the coupon and your teacher or school ID at checkout
4. K-12 and college teachers, faculty, and school staff eligible
5. In-store only; check the app for current offers
keywords: Staples, teacher discount, educator, 20% off, school supplies, office supplies, classroom
